description.from:
Build step 3 of the image toolchain (design: project/wiki/image-toolchain.md, section 9).

First commit: the upload function's new roles, image types and 10 MB cap (5.8). Then Administration > Policies > Visual style (prose, structured form, Examples grid with add and remove, review setting buttons), `image_profile_example_add`/`_remove`, `profile diff`/`init`. Then write MoM's profile, examples and `imageReview: after_the_fact` (with Ryan's review) through the signed-in CLI.

Specs: `features/newsroom/visual-style-admin.feature` and `image-profile-examples.feature`: upload, wrong type or size refused, removing an example keeps it in older versions, identifiable pictures not sent unless a person allows it.

What deploys: Upload function + UI. MoM data write after Ryan reviews the document.

Fulfils or changes: e4bdd096.

Gherkin specs are required, and every PR merges to develop. Spending is only approved for step 6 (OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare, Machines on Machines trial; Batch where nobody waits). Style guidance is data, never code.
description.to:
Build step 3 of the image toolchain (design: project/wiki/image-toolchain.md, section 9). Revised 2026-11-07 for named image types.

First commit: the upload function's new roles, image media types and 10 MB cap (5.8). Then Administration > Policies > Visual style with Brand, Image types (list, add with "Start from", retire, per-type page with sources order and effective rules) and per-type Examples, `image_profile_example_add`/`_remove` with `imageType`, `profile diff`/`init`. Then write MoM's profile from the starter types in 5.10 (after Ryan corrects them), its examples per type and `imageReview: after_the_fact`, through the signed-in CLI.

Specs: `features/newsroom/visual-style-admin.feature` and `image-profile-examples.feature`: add and retire a type; upload to a type, wrong type or size refused; a child type does not inherit examples; removing an example keeps it in older versions; identifiable pictures not sent unless a person allows it.

What deploys: Upload function + UI. MoM data write after Ryan reviews the document.

Fulfils or changes: e4bdd096.

Gherkin specs are required. Style guidance is data, never code. Spending is only approved for step 6.
